description: This file contains unit tests for the TailscaleIntegrationSection view in a SwiftUI application. It tests various states and behaviors of the TailscaleIntegrationSection component when configured with different TailscaleService states.

classes.name: TailscaleIntegrationSectionTests
classes.description: Unit test suite for testing TailscaleIntegrationSection SwiftUI view behavior under various configurations.

methods.name: `tailscale section builds body when not installed`
methods.description: Tests the TailscaleIntegrationSection view when Tailscale is not installed or running, verifying the body builds without error.

methods.name: `tailscale section builds body for serve mode`
methods.description: Tests the view when Tailscale is installed and running in serve mode, ensuring the view constructs correctly.

methods.name: `tailscale section builds body for funnel mode`
methods.description: Tests the view when Tailscale is installed but not running, in funnel mode, and verifies it builds properly.
